name: Dry Martini
description: A classic cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, the Dry Martini is known for its crisp, clean taste. Typically garnished with an olive or a twist of lemon, it epitomizes sophistication and simplicity.

name: French Connection
description: This cocktail features equal parts of Cognac and Amaretto, creating a rich and nutty flavor profile. Served over ice in an old fashioned glass, it offers a smooth and indulgent experience.

name: Godfather
description: A simple yet sophisticated blend of Scotch and Amaretto served over ice. The Godfather cocktail combines the smoky notes of whiskey with the sweet, nutty flavor of almond liqueur for a smooth, approachable drink.

name: Kamikaze
description: A vibrant mix of vodka, triple sec, and fresh lime juice. This refreshing cocktail is served chilled, making it perfect for a lively gathering.

name: Sea Breeze
description: A refreshing blend of vodka, cranberry juice, and grapefruit juice. Served over ice in a highball glass, it offers a perfect balance of sweet and tart flavors, garnished with a lime wedge.

name: White Lady
description: A refreshing blend of gin, triple sec, and fresh lemon juice. The White Lady is a classic cocktail that perfectly balances the brightness of citrus with the botanical notes of gin.

name: Alexander
description: A delightful blend of gin, crème de cacao, and light cream, the Alexander cocktail is a creamy, chocolatey indulgence. Served chilled in a cocktail glass, it's topped with a sprinkle of nutmeg for an aromatic finish.

name: John Collins
description: The John Collins is a refreshing cocktail made with bourbon, fresh lemon juice, and sugar, topped with club soda for a light and fizzy finish. Garnished with a maraschino cherry and an orange slice, it balances sweetness and tartness for a classic sip.

name: Tipperary
description: The Tipperary is a classic cocktail combining Irish whiskey, sweet vermouth, and green Chartreuse. This stirred drink offers a harmonious blend of herbal and citrus notes, enhanced by a twist of orange peel for aroma.

name: Adam
description: A refreshing blend of dark rum, tangy lemon juice, and sweet grenadine, the Adam cocktail delivers a bright and vibrant flavor profile. This shaken cocktail is served in a chilled glass, making it a perfect choice for warm evenings or as a lively aperitif.

name: Almeria
description: A rich blend of dark rum and Kahlua, topped with a creamy egg white. This cocktail delivers a smooth and indulgent experience, beautifully balanced with flavors of coffee and molasses.

name: Affinity
description: The Affinity cocktail combines Scotch whisky, sweet vermouth, and dry vermouth, enhanced with a dash of orange bitters. This sophisticated drink is stirred and served straight up, offering a balanced blend of flavors.

name: Acapulco
description: A refreshing blend of light rum, triple sec, and fresh lime juice, sweetened with sugar and served with a frothy egg white. Garnished with mint, this cocktail offers a tropical twist perfect for warm weather.

name: Algonquin
description: A refreshing blend of blended whiskey, dry vermouth, and pineapple juice. This cocktail balances the smoothness of whiskey with the sweetness and acidity of pineapple, creating a vibrant drink.

name: Artillery
description: A balanced blend of gin and sweet vermouth with a touch of bitters. The Artillery is a smooth and slightly sweet cocktail, perfect for those who enjoy a complex flavor profile with a hint of herbal notes.

name: Boxcar
description: A refreshing cocktail featuring gin, triple sec, and lemon juice, balanced with a touch of grenadine for sweetness and an egg white for a silky texture. Typically served in a sour glass, this drink offers a vibrant appearance and delightful flavor profile.

name: Balmoral
description: A sophisticated blend of Scotch, sweet vermouth, and dry vermouth, the Balmoral cocktail is finished with a dash of bitters. It offers a rich and complex flavor profile served elegantly in a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Bluebird
description: A refreshing blend of gin, triple sec, and blue curacao, enhanced with bitters. This vibrant cocktail is garnished with a twist of lemon peel and a maraschino cherry for a citrusy finish.

name: Brooklyn

name: Boomerang
description: A balanced mix of gin, dry vermouth, and maraschino liqueur, accented with bitters for depth. This classic cocktail is served straight up and garnished with a cherry for a touch of sweetness.

name: Boston Sour
description: The Boston Sour combines blended whiskey with fresh lemon juice and powdered sugar, creating a refreshing and slightly sweet sour drink. Finished with a fluffy egg white froth, garnished with a slice of lemon and a cherry, it's a delightful variation of the classic whiskey sour.

name: Casa Blanca
description: A bright and refreshing cocktail made with light rum, triple sec, lime juice, and maraschino liqueur. This delightful mix offers a balanced combination of citrus notes and a hint of cherry sweetness.

name: City Slicker
description: A refreshing blend of brandy, triple sec, and lemon juice. This cocktail offers a bright and zesty flavor profile, perfect as an uplifting aperitif.

name: Chicago Fizz
description: A refreshing cocktail combining light rum and port with a zesty lemon flavor, balanced by the creaminess of egg white and the fizz of carbonated water. This highball drink is a delightful blend of sweet and tart, perfect for a laid-back evening.

name: Casino Royale
description: A refreshing cocktail combining gin, fresh lemon juice, fragrant maraschino liqueur, and a dash of orange bitters, rounded off with a rich egg yolk. Served chilled in a sour glass for a smooth and slightly frothy finish.

name: Derby
description: A refreshing cocktail featuring gin, Peach Bitters, and fresh mint. This vibrant mix is stirred to maintain its crispness and is elegantly garnished with a sprig of mint.

name: Dry Rob Roy
description: A refined and sophisticated cocktail made with Scotch and dry vermouth, garnished with a lemon twist for a hint of citrus brightness. The Dry Rob Roy is a perfect blend of herbal notes from the vermouth and the smokiness of the Scotch, served chilled in a classic cocktail glass.

name: English Highball
description: A refreshing and effervescent cocktail featuring gin, brandy, and sweet vermouth topped with carbonated water. Served over ice with a twist of lemon peel, it offers a delightful balance of flavors.

name: Flying Dutchman
description: A simple yet elegant gin cocktail featuring equal parts gin and triple sec. Served over ice with a smooth and slightly herbal character, this drink is perfect for those who enjoy a balanced spirit-forward experience.

name: Frozen Daiquiri

name: Flying Scotchman
description: A classic blend of Scotch and sweet vermouth, accented with bitters and sugar syrup. This cocktail offers a smooth, rich flavor with a hint of sweetness, perfect for sipping before dinner.

name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
description: A refreshing blend of light rum, fresh lime juice, mint leaves, and sugar, frozen with crushed ice for a slushy consistency. This cocktail is served in an old-fashioned glass, perfect for a hot day.

name: Godchild

name: Gin Sour
description: A refreshing cocktail combining gin, fresh lemon juice, and sugar for a balance of tartness and sweetness. Garnished with an orange slice and a maraschino cherry, it's a delightful sipper perfect for any occasion.

name: Godmother
description: A simple blend of vodka and amaretto served over ice. This cocktail offers a sweet, nutty flavor profile while maintaining a smooth character.

name: Gin Toddy
description: A classic warm drink combining gin, powdered sugar, and water, garnished with a twist of lemon peel. Served in an old-fashioned glass, it offers a soothing and mildly sweet experience.

name: Gin Smash
description: A refreshing cocktail combining gin with muddled mint, sugar, and a hint of fruitiness from orange and cherry. This invigorating drink is topped with a splash of carbonated water for a fizzy finish.

name: Gin Daisy
description: A refreshing blend of gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine. This cocktail is served over ice in an old-fashioned glass, garnished with a maraschino cherry and an orange slice.

name: Gin Lemon

name: Gin Sling

name: Greyhound

name: Gin Swizzle
description: A refreshing combination of gin, lime juice, and sugar complemented by bitters, topped with club soda for a fizzy finish. This invigorating swizzle-style cocktail is served over ice and perfect for warm weather.

name: Gin and Soda
description: A refreshing and simple cocktail made with gin and soda water, finished with a wedge of lime. It is a light and effervescent drink, perfect for warm weather.

name: Honey Bee
description: A refreshing cocktail made with white rum, honey, and lemon juice. Served over crushed ice, this drink balances sweetness and acidity perfectly, making it an ideal choice for warm-weather sipping.

name: Havana Cocktail

name: Hawaiian Cocktail

name: Highland Fling Cocktail

name: Imperial Fizz

name: Imperial Cocktail

name: Japanese Fizz

name: Jewel Of The Nile

name: Loch Lomond
description: A blend of Scotch whisky, Drambuie, and dry vermouth, this balanced cocktail offers a unique combination of sweetness and herbal complexity, finished with a twist of lemon peel. Ideal as a smooth pre-dinner drink or a digestif, it exhibits a rich flavor profile.

name: London Town

name: Lady Love Fizz

name: Lone Tree Cocktail

name: Long Island Iced Tea

name: Monkey Wrench

name: Orgasm

name: Old Cuban

name: Orange Whip

name: Pink Lady

name: Poppy Cocktail

name: Rum Toddy

name: Royal Gin Fizz

name: Rum Screwdriver

name: Russian Spring Punch

name: Scooter

name: Salty Dog

name: Scotch Sour

name: Tequila Sour
description: A refreshing blend of tequila and mezcal, paired with tart lemon juice and sweetened with powdered sugar. This cocktail is served over ice in a whiskey sour glass, garnished with a lemon slice and a cherry.

name: The Jimmy Conway
description: A refreshing blend of Irish whiskey, Amaretto, and cranberry juice, the Jimmy Conway balances the rich nuttiness of Amaretto with the tartness of cranberry. Served over ice with a lemon garnish, it offers a fruity twist on classic whiskey cocktails.

name: Victor

name: Vesuvio

name: Vodka Lemon
description: A refreshing blend of vodka and fresh lemon juice, served over ice in a highball glass. Garnished with a slice of lemon and optionally adorned with mint leaves for added freshness.

name: Vodka Martini
description: A classic cocktail consisting of vodka and dry vermouth, served with an olive. It's a crisp and clean drink, ideal for any occasion.

name: Waikiki Beachcomber
